facts.text: Jolene mentioned that she has been studying hard due to finals coming up this month.

evidence.quote: Got a lot of finals coming up this month, so I've been studying real hard.

facts.text: Jolene expressed that she plans to take a trip to relax and recharge after completing her finals.

evidence.quote: Thinking about taking a trip somewhere to relax and recharge afterward.

facts.text: Jolene mentioned that playing games like 'Monster Hunter: World' is her way to de-stress and take a break from life.

evidence.quote: It's my way to de-stress and take a break from life.
One of my favorites was 'Monster Hunter: World'. The immersive story and open-world gaming are amazing!
